svc_hero_h1: The landscaping work we take on

services.title: Lawn care and mowing
services.body: Lawns are cut, edged and cleaned up on a schedule so the yard never gets ahead of you.
services.alt: Brick-edged planting bed of liriope along a pale blue house wall by the front walk.

evidence.text: Mowed back lawn with fence lines and a patio set behind a tall tan house.

services.title: Mulch and bed work
services.body: Beds are cleaned out, edged and mulched, and plantings are set where they will actually grow.
services.alt: Foundation bed of new shrubs and mulch along a tan house wall beside the air conditioner.

evidence.text: Stone-front house with a new black-mulched foundation bed of shrubs along the walk.

services.title: Hardscape, patios and walkways
services.body: Base is compacted and screeded before a single paver or block goes down, which is why it stays level.
services.alt: Curved stone retaining wall bed with a weeping tree and shrubs beside a white house.

evidence.text: Light blue ranch house with a paver-edged bed, hanging flower basket and fresh mulch at the corner.

services.title: Sod, seeding and grading
services.body: The ground is graded and prepped first, then sodded or seeded so the new lawn takes instead of washing out.
services.alt: Back lawn bordered by a chain-link fence with a red maple and fresh mulch beds along it.

evidence.text: Stone-block edged bed of fresh topsoil and small shrubs along a white house corner.

services.title: Tree and shrub trimming
services.body: Hedges and ornamentals are shaped and dead wood comes out so they fill in instead of going leggy.
services.alt: Above-ground pool with a fresh mulch ring and a white fence behind it in a back yard.

evidence.text: Tan two-storey colonial with trimmed foundation shrubs and a mulched bed across the front.

reviews_h2: What people are saying about the landscaping

reviews.author: John Mack
reviews.text: I had Straightforward Landscaping perform design and installation of shrubbery and plants for my corner property. Jake and his team were extremely professional and provided excellent service. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone needing landscaping or any type of lawn work.

reviews.author: Mike Cantwell
reviews.text: Straightforward Landscaping did an excellent job trimming and mulching our property. First time using them and we are very satisfied with the service and look. Highly recommend them for all your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Kimberly Curiale
reviews.text: Jake and his team transformed our backyard. We were so happy with the quality work they provided and they were very efficient, we will certainly be using them again for more projects !

reviews.author: Jill D'Amato
reviews.text: Jake and his crew were professional and efficient. I would definitely recommend Straightforward Landscaping for your landscaping needs.
